items.html:
A right-handed batsman, Noor-ul-Haq had an excellent campaign at the Under-19 World Cup qualifiers, scoring 216 runs in seven games, averaging 54. His cricketing idol is Sachin Tendulkar.
Cricinfo Staff January 2010
